questions.explanation: The frontal lobe, particularly the prefrontal cortex, handles executive functions.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Neurosciences

questions.question: During extension of the lumbar spine the intervertebral foramen:
questions.explanation: Extension narrows the foramen while flexion opens it.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Kinesio Therapeutics

questions.question: A patient in a phase I cardiac rehabilitation program begins walking with assistance. Which following monitoring techniques would not be necessary in a phase I program?
questions.explanation: EMG is not part of phase I monitoring; BP, HR and ECG are.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: A therapist practices assessing joint end-feel. The therapist would most accurately classify normal elbow extension end-feel as:
questions.explanation: Elbow extension has a hard (bony) end-feel.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: The stress on a joint is minimal and its capsule is most lax in the:
questions.explanation: In the loose-packed position the joint surfaces are least congruent and the capsule is slack, so joint play is maximal.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: The reaction seen under the cathode when a direct current is passed through it is:
questions.explanation: The cathode produces an alkaline reaction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: Which class is lever of power:
questions.explanation: Second-class levers favour force (power) while third-class levers favour speed and range of motion.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 30
questions.subject: Kinesio Therapeutics

questions.question: Deficiency of which vitamin causes pernicious anaemia?
questions.explanation: Lack of intrinsic factor leads to B12 malabsorption.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Medicine

questions.question: A therapist performs a talar tilt test on a 22-year-old female rehabilitating from an inversion ankle sprain. Which ligament does the talar tilt test examine?
questions.explanation: The talar tilt test (inversion stress) tests the calcaneofibular ligament.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: During swing phase of gait, GRF is:
questions.explanation: During swing phase the foot is off the ground so there is no ground reaction force.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Kinesio Therapeutics

questions.question: When skin from another species is used for grafting, it is called a:
questions.explanation: A xenograft (heterograft) comes from another species, e.g. pig skin.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: General Surgery & Orthopedics

questions.question: The normal amount of air exchanged during quiet respiration (tidal volume) is about:
questions.explanation: Resting tidal volume is about 6-8 mL/kg, around 500 mL.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiology

questions.question: The source of fat emboli is probably the:
questions.explanation: The source of fat emboli after fracture is the bone marrow.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: General Surgery & Orthopedics

questions.question: An 18-year-old male six weeks status postopen reduction of a Colle's fracture is referred to physical therapy. Examination reveals mild swelling on the dorsum of the hand and limited flexion of the metacarpophalangeal joints in all digits. The most appropriate heating agent for the patent is:
questions.explanation: Paraffin is suitable for a stiff hand after a Colles' fracture.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: A pressure ulcer that presents as a deep crater (full-thickness skin loss) is:
questions.explanation: Stage 3: full-thickness loss with visible subcutaneous fat but no muscle or bone.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Pathology & Microbiology
